formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: SLES (2) defining, one prominent buffer (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 4), no reinforcing anionic -> moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 met with a payload lipid in place of the silicone: prominent Stearyl Alcohol (6), cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-6 14, Guar HPTC 15), fatty route (Cetyl Alcohol 9, Trihydroxystearin 17) and closed-list humectants (Glycerin 12, Panthenol 20, Sodium Hyaluronate 23) -> high. W-RICH also holds.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Both cationic polymers and all humectants are after Parfum; fatty alcohols in a shampoo may act mainly as opacifier/structurant.

weightPotential.rationale: W-RICH (prominent stearyl alcohol + two cationic polymers) plausibly leaves bounded residue, but the C1 chassis gives moderate (not limited) reset -> moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: W-RICH and two converging cationic polymers argue high.

persistence.rationale: Fatty-alcohol/cationic coacervate deposits moderately; no silicone.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Converging lipid and cationic routes, ordinary reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH is present but reset is moderate (not limited), the cationics are after Parfum and there is no silicone. Not low: prominent fatty alcohols plus two cationic polymers are converging families (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Role/level of the fatty alcohols and cationic polymers; W-RICH vs. moderate reset.
